$comment: Protocol 1 between the desktop and an app's Python worker: NDJSON on stdin and stdout, one object per line, at most 1 MiB. Host call ids (id) and worker request ids (rid) are separate spaces. Generates docs/protocol.md and the TypeScript message types.

ready: First line. The host refuses the worker if it uses a permission app.json doesn't declare.
fatal: The app could not load. The worker exits.
progress: From ox.progress. Coalesced to 20 a second.
event: From ox.emit. The host forwards it to the page that made call id.
result: What the action returned, as JSON. Exports become {items: [Item]}.
error: Codes: bad_input, problem, cancelled (with kept), crashed.
library: Add a file to the Library. Answered by library-result.
cloud: An allow-listed cloud call. The token never reaches the worker.

call: Run an action. The host has already checked input against its schema.
cancel: Stop: the action's next ox.progress raises ox.Cancelled.
library-result: The answer to a library request.
cloud-result: The answer to a cloud request.
shutdown: Finish, then exit. The host kills the worker after 3 s.

types.ActionSpec: {name, title, input: JSON Schema object whose properties carry "x-ox": {control, accept?, multiple?, label?, placeholder?, step?}, timeout: seconds}
types.Item: {id, kind: sound | midi | other, title, path}
